justification: Assessment reported INVALID and pinpointed the same defect as ground truth: the sign error in the roots of X^2 + sqrt5 X - (-1)^m (odd case roots are -phi and -phi^{-1}, not phi^{-1}; it also notes the parallel even-case slip), with the same fatal consequence that the converse construction forces F_{k'-1} = +1 instead of -1. Its mod-11 numeric trace (F_99 = 1 mod 11, not -1) is a different-but-valid witness for the same claim the ground truth witnesses mod 7^2.
